ldsStatus: Exception to LDS 0.9.7: LDS has 20 analytical scales and none for land elevation (the water scale is for water level/depth). Used at the owner’s request in chat on 2026-10-20 (asked for OH3-style height colours and several easy-to-read sets) for the terrain layer only.
themes: same HEX on light and dark surfaces; no dark-mode formula or inversion

mapping.default: equalize: each colour covers a similar share of the area in view (101 in-view percentiles from 0.5 to 99.5); linear in metres available
mapping.bands: on by default: one colour per contour interval, sampled at the band middle
mapping.reasonForDefault: Sila is mostly flat (half of the municipal area is below about 160 m by FABDEM); linear colours leave most low ground in one colour, equal-area colours separate it. Owner asked on 2026-10-20 for an easy, realistic default with several sets to choose from.
mapping.interpolation: linear between listed stops in sRGB, 256-step lookup

contours.default: finest step with at most 100 lines across the in-view relief (1st-99th percentile)
contours.densityFade: minor lines fade out below about 10 CSS px apart (gone at 4 px), major lines below 8 px (gone at 3 px); dark theme draws the light lines at 70% strength; 3D measures spacing in CSS pixels

source.name: OH3 Dynamic Elevation Map palettes as implemented in the CityMETER terrain viewer

oh3-relief-lowland.label: Natural, lowland (site default)
oh3-relief-lowland.sourceLabel: Derived: first 7 stops of OH3 Dynamic Elevation Map relief (Imhof-style tint), without the grey and white peak tints

oh3-relief.label: OH3 relief
oh3-relief.sourceLabel: OH3 Dynamic Elevation Map, relief (Imhof-style tint)

accuracyNote: FABDEM mean absolute vertical error about 1.12 m in built-up areas and 2.88 m in forest (Hawker et al. 2022, https://www.fathom.global/academic-papers/a-30-m-global-map-of-elevation-with-forests-and-buildings-removed/); contours finer than 1 m show model form, not surveyed levels.
